title: CHAIN OF THOUGHT — organism reasoning pipeline + full taxonomy + all sorts

pipeline.name: TRAIN OF THOUGHT — the organism's reasoning chain

stages.name: INTAKE
stages.action: raw entropy input — typos, passion, direction, chaos

stages.name: SCATTER
stages.action: fan entropy into ring sets — BLAKE2b hash → seed → distribute across rings
stages.etymology: scatter — Old Norse skattr, to spread widely

stages.name: SUGGEST
stages.action: from ring sets, suggest what to work on next. organism-mapped elements first.
stages.etymology: suggest — Latin sub + gerere, to carry underneath

stages.name: EXECUTE
stages.action: build what was suggested. validate against taxonomy. fill in missing fields.
stages.etymology: execute — Latin ex + sequi, to follow out

stages.name: PLACE
stages.action: place the atom in the taxonomy. update completeness. connect to existing knowledge.
stages.etymology: place — Latin platea, a broad way

stages.name: CACHE
stages.action: store result as prior for next iteration. chain to previous work. lessons.json grows.
stages.etymology: cache — French cacher, to hide (store for later)

stages.name: REASON UP
stages.action: prove the result back up the chain. answer reaches Kevin. train of thought complete.
stages.etymology: reason — Latin ratio, to reckon, to count

pipeline.loop: every task fills more taxonomy. every fill caches as prior. every prior makes next task faster. THIS IS FERMENTATION — breaking complex (entropy) into simple (atoms) and distributing (specifically).
pipeline.applied_etymology: every concept in the organism is NAMED. every name is TRACED to its root. the root IS the meaning. applied etymology = understanding by naming. Gaia is an etymologist because NAMING is KNOWING.

taxonomy_status.next_to_fill: art (115 elements undrawn), fermentation (111 unfermented), organism (102 unmapped)
